form_analysis.feedback: Excellent sugaring aftercare form with clear time-phased instructions and specific guidance for this natural hair removal method. Includes valuable information on preventing ingrown hairs, appropriate exfoliation timing, and maintaining results between sessions. Well-structured with appropriate emergency guidance.

form_data.treatment_description: Thank you for choosing Sugaring for your hair removal. This gentle, natural method removes hair from the root for smoother skin.
form_data.introduction: Proper aftercare is important to reduce irritation, prevent ingrown hairs, and keep your skin looking and feeling its best.

sections.title: Mild Redness or Sensitivity
sections.content: It’s normal for the skin to look slightly pink or feel tender for a few hours. Any mild swelling should subside within the day.

sections.title: Avoid Touching
sections.content: Do not touch, scratch, or rub the treated area to prevent irritation and bacteria from entering the hair follicles.

sections.title: Clothing Choice
sections.content: Wear loose-fitting clothing to allow your skin to breathe and avoid friction.

items: Avoid hot showers, baths, saunas, steam rooms, or hot tubs.
Do not apply perfumed lotions, deodorants, or makeup on the treated area.
Avoid swimming in pools or the sea, as chlorine and salt can irritate freshly sugared skin.
Skip strenuous exercise that causes excessive sweating.

sections.title: Sun Exposure
sections.content: Avoid direct sunlight and tanning beds for at least 48 hours. Always use SPF 30 or higher if the area will be exposed.

sections.title: Exfoliation
sections.content: Do not exfoliate for the first 48 hours.

sections.title: Moisturising
sections.content: Use a gentle, fragrance-free moisturiser to soothe and hydrate the skin.

sections.title: Exfoliate Regularly
sections.content: Begin gentle exfoliation 2–3 times a week to help prevent ingrown hairs. Use a mild scrub, exfoliating mitt, or chemical exfoliant recommended by your practitioner.

sections.title: Hydrate the Skin
sections.content: Keep the skin moisturised daily to maintain softness and reduce dryness.

ongoing_care.title: Ongoing Care
items: Avoid shaving between sugaring appointments to maintain smoother regrowth.
Book your next session every 4–6 weeks for best results.
Wear SPF on exposed areas to protect your skin.

normal_reactions.title: Possible Reactions
normal_reactions.note: These are normal and should resolve quickly.

emergency_guidance.title: When to Contact Your Practitioner
items: Pus, spreading rash, or signs of infection
